summary: Both full halves inspected. The folio353 has repeated regular numeral forms matching the neighboring unretouched folio digits;the prior confident handwriting attribution is removed,with provenance uncertainty recorded. Property exchanges p/e over older e/p impressions. Total and the later a are typed interlinear additions. The parenthesis after connected is pen-retouched over a thinner parenthesis impression. The literal spelling termihology is visible and retained. In the first accordance,a overlies i and c overlies g. Within has pen retouching across wit,whose underlying details remain tentative. Have has v over t. The heavily retouched beginning of concrete has unresolved C/c case and an unreadable old first impression;the o and n corrections are separately preserved. The h in Therefore is readable,but a separate small upper pen mark is not. All three category occurrences were enlarged;none securely yields an additional old character. The final three pen crosses form a triangular divider,not a typed baseline of x characters.

edits.reason: The repeated3 forms and regular5 match the unretouched gray numeral impressions on neighboring folios. The image does not securely establish a pen layer for353;remove the categorical handwriting attribution and record the unresolved provenance.
The p retains an old e crossbar and bowl;the following e retains an old p descender. Preserve both cells of the typed exchange.
Total has regular typewriter letterforms above the line. Only its placement bracket is pen.
The thick pen parenthesis retraces a thinner parenthesis impression that remains visible along its inner side.
The a retains an old i dot and stem;the c retains the lower loop of an old g. Both overprints are visible in this occurrence.
The initial wit is retouched in pen. Several earlier typed strokes remain visible,but the crowded middle details make the complete old wit reading tentative.
The v has an old t upright,crossbar,and lower curl beneath it.
The inserted a is a regular typed impression above the line,bracketed into place in pen.

The first three letters are heavily pen-retouched. The first live open curve does not securely distinguish capitalC from lowercasec,and its old impression is unreadable. The o retouches o,and the n overlies a visible a bowl.
The live h ascender and arch are clear over a typed h. A separate small curved pen mark above it remains uninterpreted and is retained as unreadable rather than dropped.
The three marks are handwritten crosses arranged with two above and one centered below. Preserve their triangular divider layout and pen provenance.

diff.7742: The source closing quotation marks follow 0-connected and precede the right parenthesis. Their placement is retained rather than moved to follow aspheric.
